apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(player): restore the spinning retry icon and let the source chips pan with the mouse (`721bfdb3`)
- fix(player): recover stalled playback after network loss and keep the last frame while buffering (`77944c1a`)
- fix(torrent): restart the torrent when the network returns (`cc2ba47b`)
- fix(player): scroll the source chips sideways on mobile and make retry a chip (`9b174da6`)
- perf(home): hold the hero carousel until loading settles (`0627d2aa`)
- perf(host): wake on projector results and poll queued dispatches without full frames (`1514c895`)
- perf(host): skip full frames when only artwork polling is due (`35a82b55`)
- perf(host): compute stream provider availability on the projector thread (`19119215`)
- fix(tv): always show the focus ring on TV (`86d1f586`)
- fix(tv): fit the profile picker inside the TV viewport (`af48302b`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.4...v0.3.5
